name: External Undertaking Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external undertaking type code in the format of a character string with a maximum length of 4 characters. The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

APAY.name: Advance Payment
APAY.definition: Undertaking in support of an advance payment obligation.

COMM.name: Commercial
COMM.definition: Undertaking in support of a commercial obligation.

CUST.name: Customs
CUST.definition: Undertaking in support of a customs duty obligation.

DPAY.name: Direct Pay
DPAY.definition: Undertaking representing the primary means of payment.

FINC.name: Financial
FINC.definition: Undertaking in support of a financial obligation.

INSU.name: Insurance
INSU.definition: Undertaking in support of a insurance obligation.

IRBO.name: Industrial Revenue Board
IRBO.definition: Undertaking in support of an Industrial Revenue Board (IRB) obligation.

MAIN.name: Maintenance
MAIN.definition: Undertaking in support of a maintenance obligation.

PAYM.name: Payment
PAYM.definition: Undertaking in support of a payment obligation.

PERF.name: Performance
PERF.definition: Undertaking in support of a performance obligation.

RETN.name: Retention
RETN.definition: Undertaking in support of a monetary retention obligation.

SHIP.name: Shipping
SHIP.definition: Undertaking in support of a sea transportation obligation.

TEND.name: Tender Or Bid
TEND.definition: Undertaking in support of a tender or bid obligation.

WARR.name: Warranty
WARR.definition: Undertaking in support of a warranty obligation.
